change: Daily Report Status column now shows the EOD Balance reason directly (e.g. 'PENDING - AWAITING FOR DRIVER') instead of generic 'PENDING - IN YARD', matching what Security sees on their own EOD Balance list. Previously the reason was only visible buried in the All Faults list; now it's visible at a glance in Status too. Applies to the on-screen Daily Report, the XLSX download, and the Combined Report sheet.
